text: but you have to be tasteful. dont show me that shit right as i hover over it. only pop it up after ive levft my mouse there like an undecisive idiot otherwise it will be annoying as shit
resolution: Called off with req_1914. This was the taste constraint on the popover: never pop on immediate hover, only after the cursor dwells (the Tooltip's delayMs pattern, ~500ms) so sweeping across the grid isn't 'annoying as shit'. Moot now that the popover viewer itself was shelved (req_1916) — the auto-framed static thumbnails are the accepted result and need no hover affordance. Recorded for if the interactive popover is ever picked back up.
